title: Semi-representable objects over a scheme, their coverings and hypercovers
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme with small etale site $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], whose final object is $\mathrm{id}_X$. (1) The category $\mathrm{SR}(X)$ of *semi-representable objects over $X$* is the category of formal coproducts $\mathrm{SR}(X_{\Et})$ of [def-weil-pbc-formal-coproduct] (Stacks' $\mathrm{SR}(\mathcal C,X)=\mathrm{SR}(\mathcal C/X)$ for $\mathcal C=X_{\Et}$, where $\mathcal C/X=\mathcal C$): its objects are families $\{U_i\to X\}_{i\in I}$ of objects of $X_{\Et}$ indexed by a set $I$; a morphism $\{U_i\to X\}_{i\in I}\to\{V_j\to X\}_{j\in J}$ is a pair $(\alpha,(f_i)_{i\in I})$ of a map $\alpha:I\to J$ and $X$-morphisms $f_i:U_i\to V_{\alpha(i)}$, composed by composing the index maps and the components. By [lem-weil-pbc-semi-representable-finite-limits] (applied to $\mathcal C=X_{\Et}$) it has finite limits, with final object $\{\mathrm{id}_X\}$ and the fibre products described there. (2) For an object $T$ of $X_{\Et}$, a *$T$-point* of $L=\{L_j\to X\}_{j\in J}$ is a morphism $\{T\}\to L$ of $\mathrm{SR}(X)$, i.e. by [def-weil-pbc-formal-coproduct] a pair $(j,t)$ with $j\in J$ and $t:T\to L_j$ an $X$-morphism; $L(T)$ denotes the set of $T$-points, and a morphism $L\to L'$ induces $L(T)\to L'(T)$ by composition. (3) A morphism $(\alpha,(f_i)):\{U_i\}_{i\in I}\to\{V_j\}_{j\in J}$ of $\mathrm{SR}(X)$ is a *covering* if for every $j\in J$ the family $\{f_i:U_i\to V_j\}_{i\in I,\ \alpha(i)=j}$ is a covering family of $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. (4) A *simplicial object $K$ of $\mathrm{SR}(X)$* is a simplicial object of the category $\mathrm{SR}(X)$ [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object] (a functor $\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{SR}(X)$, with $\Delta$ as in [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set]), with terms $K_n$, simplicial operators $K(\varphi)$, face maps $d_i$ and degeneracy maps $s_i$. Its *matching objects* $M_n(K)$ and *matching morphisms* $\mu_n:K_n\to M_n(K)$, $n\geq0$, are those of [lem-weil-pbc-simplicial-matching-object] for the category $\mathcal C=\mathrm{SR}(X)$ with its finite limits and final object $\{\mathrm{id}_X\}$ from (1): $M_0(K)=\{\mathrm{id}_X\}$ and $\mu_0$ the unique morphism to it; $M_1(K)=K_0\times K_0$; for $n\geq2$, $M_n(K)$ is a limit of the finite diagram with copies $K_{n-1}^{(i)}$ of $K_{n-1}$ ($0\leq i\leq n$), copies $K_{n-2}^{(i,j)}$ of $K_{n-2}$ ($0\leq i<j\leq n$) and arrows $d_{j-1}:K_{n-1}^{(i)}\to K_{n-2}^{(i,j)}$, $d_i:K_{n-1}^{(j)}\to K_{n-2}^{(i,j)}$, a limit that exists and is unique up to unique isomorphism by that lemma; for $n\geq1$, $\mu_n$ is the morphism with components $(d_0,\dots,d_n)$. By part (2) of that lemma with $W=\{T\}$, the $T$-points of $M_n(K)$ ($n\geq1$) are the tuples $(x_0,\dots,x_n)$ of $T$-points of $K_{n-1}$ with $d_{j-1}x_i=d_ix_j$ for all $0\leq i<j\leq n$. By [lem-weil-pbc-matching-object-coskeleton], for $n\geq1$, $M_n(K)$ is isomorphic to the degree-$n$ term $(\mathrm{cosk}_{n-1}\mathrm{sk}_{n-1}K)_n$ of the coskeleton [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-coskeleton] by an isomorphism carrying the degree-$n$ component of the canonical morphism $K\to\mathrm{cosk}_{n-1}\mathrm{sk}_{n-1}K$ to $\mu_n$. (5) A *hypercover of $X$ in $\mathrm{SR}(X)$* is a simplicial object $K$ of $\mathrm{SR}(X)$ such that $\mu_n:K_n\to M_n(K)$ is a covering in the sense of (3) for every $n\geq0$; for $n=0$ this says that the family $K_0$ is a covering family of $X$ in $X_{\Et}$.

split_report.summary: Definition split against hypercovering.tex 01G0, 01G2, 01G3, 01G5 and simplicial.tex 016A, 0180, 0AMA, 0183, 0186 (tags checked in tags/tags). Statement kept in substance; every notion now cites a node: the category is the new Mathlib leaf def-weil-pbc-formal-coproduct (FormalCoproduct, incl, inclHomEquiv for T-points) applied to X_Et, its finite limits the leaf lem-weil-pbc-semi-representable-finite-limits; simplicial objects the new leaf def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object (SimplicialObject, delta, sigma) over def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set; coverings use the covering families of def-weil-pbc-etale-site. The claims the old text made inside the definition were moved out: existence and uniqueness of the matching object, its description by tuples of faces, and the existence of the matching morphism (which needs the simplicial identity d_{j-1}d_i = d_id_j) are the new generic statement lem-weil-pbc-simplicial-matching-object; the agreement with Stacks' (cosk_{n-1}sk_{n-1}K)_n of 01G5 (0183 + 0186) is the new statement lem-weil-pbc-matching-object-coskeleton, with the coskeleton the new leaf def-weil-pbc-simplicial-coskeleton (Mathlib's Truncated.cosk as right Kan extension, coskAdj). For the citer lem-weil-pbc-hypercover-refinement (step 5 applies the SR(X) lifting lemma to scheme hypercovers) the new statement lem-weil-pbc-sr-matching-object-one-member says that a simplicial etale X-scheme gives a simplicial object of one-member families whose SR(X) matching objects are the matching schemes, so the two hypercover notions agree; nothing cites it yet (flagged unreachable). No sorry-free slopmaster2 declaration states any of these (grep of WeilConjectures and Comparator for the id, semi-representable, FormalCoproduct, matching, hypercover: only a Cech use of FormalCoproduct and 0-hypercovers).
